description: This file serves as an index/export aggregator for various helper functions, types, and classes related to QMD session and query processing in the memory engine. It re-exports functions and types from multiple modules related to query expansion, session file handling, QMD query parsing, scope derivation, and process management.

classes.name: SessionFileEntry
classes.description: Type representing an entry for session files related to an agent in the system.

methods.name: extractKeywords
methods.description: Function to extract keywords from queries or tokens for expansion.

methods.name: isQueryStopWordToken
methods.description: Function to determine if a token is a stop word in query processing.

methods.name: buildSessionEntry
methods.description: Function to construct a session file entry based on context.

methods.name: listSessionFilesForAgent
methods.description: Function to list all session files associated with a specific agent.

methods.name: sessionPathForFile
methods.description: Function to generate or retrieve the file system path for a session.

methods.name: parseQmdQueryJson
methods.description: Function to parse QMD query JSON into usable data structures.

methods.name: deriveQmdScopeChannel
methods.description: Function to derive scope channel information from context.

methods.name: deriveQmdScopeChatType
methods.description: Function to determine chat type based on scope.

methods.name: isQmdScopeAllowed
methods.description: Function to check if a given scope is permitted within current constraints.

methods.name: checkQmdBinaryAvailability
methods.description: Function to verify if the QMD binary is available in the environment.

methods.name: resolveCliSpawnInvocation
methods.description: Function to resolve the command-line invocation details for spawning QMD process.

methods.name: runCliCommand
methods.description: Function to execute command-line commands for managing QMD-related operations.
